payload.explanation: Install and enable a custom Omarchy service plugin that registers Super plus keypad digit bindings for workspaces 1 through 10, Super plus keypad Enter for the terminal, and both Num Lock keysym variants.

reference.source_description: Public plugin repository named by the journal; the exact historical version and commit were not recorded.

payload.effects: The plugin runs unsandboxed shell code, changes the default Num Lock setting for the active compositor session, and registers 21 keypad bindings.
payload.rollback: Remove or disable the custom plugin, then reload Hyprland so its dynamic keypad bindings are absent.
payload.validation_plan: Inspect the live binding table for all 21 keypad keysyms, then physically test representative workspace and terminal bindings with Num Lock on and off on the intended external-keyboard-through-dock setup.

activation.details: Load the plugin service through the Omarchy shell, then verify its bindings in Hyprland.
